title: SIU investigating death of man while in police custody
subtitle: The Special Investigation Unit (SIU) has been called in to investigate after a 27-year-old man died while in police custody early Sunday morning.
article: The Special Investigation Unit (SIU) has been called in to investigate after a 27-year-old man died while in police custody early Sunday morning.
Kawartha Lakes Police say officers were called to the Admiral Inn on Highway 7 at about 3 a.m. regarding a disturbance.
After further investigation, police say the man was arrested and then collapsed a short time later.
Police say officers on scene began CPR and arriving EMS paramedics and firefighters administered advanced life support. The man could not be revived and was pronounced dead at the scene.
His name has not been released.
The SIU is responsible for investigating any death or serious injury that occurs while a person is in police custody.
